summary: Chemomab Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing Q1 2026 financial results and a corporate update. The release discusses clinical data presentations for nebokitug in PSC and progress on partnership discussions, but does not disclose any specific acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report with no special-situation event.
